message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Tech enthusiasts gaining practical tech insights caught our attention, and your video on recovering deleted files from a PC stood out. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes and sustainable institutional growth. We are reaching out to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives your audience valuable tools for institutional technology integration. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
